_meta.note: Canonical source of truth. All derived theme files are generated from this. Do not edit derived files directly — update this file and regenerate.
_meta.hyperlink_note: hyperlink and followedHyperlink are aliases of accent1 and accent2 respectively. If accent1 or accent2 change, these two entries MUST be updated to match manually — JSON has no native reference mechanism.
_meta.role_aliases_note: tx1/tx2/tx3/bg1/bg2 are logical role aliases. They DO NOT appear in theme1.xml — OOXML clrScheme uses fixed slot names (dk1/lt1/dk2/lt2/accent1-6/hlink/folHlink). For .docx files, role mapping is materialised in word/settings.xml via clrSchemeMapping (see settings-clrSchemeMapping.xml).
_meta.font_fallback_note: fallback_chain promotes Helvetica Neue to second position — it is the closest visual match to TWK Everett available pre-installed on macOS. Office (.docx/.pptx/.xlsx) does NOT honour this chain — Word substitutes silently using its own logic when TWK Everett is absent. The chain only governs HTML/CSS/SVG/React renderings.

dk1.property: True black — structural ink (gridlines, strokes, rules); NOT used for body text

lt1.property: Pure white — secondary background (high-contrast cards, table data rows)

dk2.property: Near-black navy — primary text on light backgrounds

lt2.property: Warm cream — primary background (pages, slides, default canvas)

accent1.property: Electric blue — primary brand fill; alias of tx3 when used as text

accent2.property: Sky blue — secondary fill; alias of tx2 when used as text on dark backgrounds

accent3.property: Ice blue — tints, washes, code-block fills, banded table rows

accent4.property: Steel blue (muted) — dividers, muted labels, blockquote text

accent5.property: Violet-blue — alternate accent for badges, tags

accent6.property: Periwinkle (soft) — soft accent for tooltips, light badges

hyperlink.property: Hyperlink — alias of accent1; keep in sync

followedHyperlink.property: Followed link — alias of accent2; keep in sync

tx1.use: Primary text on light backgrounds (body copy, headings, table cells, captions)

tx2.use: Secondary text on dark backgrounds only (e.g. text on dk1/dk2 fills). Never on light backgrounds — fails WCAG AA at 2.1:1.

tx3.use: Tertiary text — emphasis only. Restricted to specific elements (see text_role_constraints).

bg1.use: Primary light background — pages, slides, default canvas

bg2.use: Secondary light background — high-contrast cards, table data rows, code block frames

tx2.rule: tx2 only legible on dark fills (dk1 #000000 or dk2 #0F0E2B). On any light background fails WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 (4.5:1 minimum).

tx3.rule: Brand-color text must always pair with a non-color visual cue (underline for hyperlinks, button shape for CTAs, indent + italic for callouts). Never use as generic emphasis in running text — readers will misread it as a hyperlink.

font_family.fallback_chain: TWK Everett Light, Helvetica Neue, system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, sans-serif

h3.use: Sub-sub-section; numbering recommended (e.g. 4.1.1); extra left indent

blockquote.use: Callouts, asides, indicative passages. Italic + indent provide non-color cues per WCAG SC 1.4.1.

code_block.use: Code samples, command-line snippets, configuration excerpts

code_inline.use: Inline code references within paragraph text

default_style.row_order: data_row_fill leads (first data row); banded_row_fill follows; alternating thereafter
default_style.use: Default table styling. Header in accent2; first data row accent3 (ice blue), alternating with bg2 (white); 0.5pt accent2 borders on all cell edges. Header bottom edge is intentionally invisible (border = header fill).
default_style.wcag_note: Border-vs-fill contrast is ~1.9:1 against bg2 and ~1.4:1 against accent3 — fails WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 (3:1 non-text contrast). Borders here are decorative; row distinction is carried by the alternating fills, not the borders. Do not cite this style as WCAG-compliant for non-text contrast.

contrast_pairs._note: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 requires 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (>=18pt regular or >=14pt bold). All entries below verified against canonical hex.
